description: This file declares the ProxyConfigServiceAndroid class, which manages proxy configuration on Android within the Chromium project. It includes callback definitions, nested classes, and methods for setting and retrieving proxy configurations, as well as handling proxy override rules.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceAndroid
classes.description: Manages Android-specific proxy configuration, including PAC resolution and proxy override rules.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceAndroid::JNIDelegate
classes.description: Interface for JNI callbacks related to proxy settings changes.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceAndroid::ProxyOverrideRule
classes.description: Represents a rule for proxy override with scheme and proxy URL.

methods.name: set_exclude_pac_url
methods.description: Enables or disables ignoring the PAC URL and using the local proxy.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for proxy configuration changes.

methods.name: RemoveObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer for proxy configuration changes.

methods.name: SetProxyOverride
methods.description: Sets proxy override rules and bypass rules, with optional callback.
